templates.name: Callout
templates.summary: A one-page local trades site with services, hours, coverage checking, and emergency callouts.
templates.description:
Callout is a complete service-business website designed for an independent plumber, electrician, or other local tradesperson who needs to build trust quickly and turn nearby visitors into phone enquiries. The template gives a small operator the credibility of a larger company without introducing a complicated CMS or administrative workflow.

The customer journey is focused on practical questions people ask before booking: what the business repairs, whether emergency help is available tonight, which neighbourhoods are covered, and how to call. Service cards, opening hours, click-to-call actions, an interactive street checker, project photography, and a clear coverage map keep those answers visible throughout the page.

All business details, services, navigation, hours, and validation messages are centralized in typed constants for quick personalization. Original illustrations, responsive layouts, accessible form behavior, and carefully tuned mobile interactions make the template ready for vibecoding into a distinctive real-world trade website.

features.name: Service overview
features.description: Clear cards for repairs, heating work, and emergency callouts.

features.name: Coverage checker
features.description: Interactive street or postcode form with an immediate status response.

features.name: Availability and hours
features.description: Prominent opening hours and tonight's emergency cover.

features.name: Click to call
features.description: Mobile-friendly phone actions placed throughout the page.

templates.name: Groom Room
templates.summary: A breed-led dog grooming site with instant guide prices, appointment times, cut photography, and booking handoff.
templates.description:
Groom Room is a polished multi-page website for an independent dog groomer who wants to replace vague “prices from” messaging with a useful first estimate. It is designed for salon owners serving local dog owners who need confidence about cost, timing, and coat outcomes before making contact.

The primary journey starts with an interactive picker covering six popular breeds. Each selection immediately updates the recommended cut, locally stored photograph, guide price, duration, care note, and pre-filled enquiry link. Four add-ons, a full service menu, transparent quote guidance, salon details, opening hours, click-to-call actions, and a four-question FAQ complete the path from browsing to booking.

Business copy, contact details, hours, links, and breed data are centralized in committed JSON files for fast personalization. The original editorial layout, responsive plain CSS, accessible controls, static multi-page Astro output, local imagery, TypeScript content shapes, and FAQPage structured data provide a strong base for a distinctive real-world grooming business site.

features.name: Breed price picker
features.description: Six breed choices instantly update the cut, guide price, appointment duration, care note, and photograph.

features.name: Service menu
features.description: Dedicated service page explains full grooms, bath and brush visits, puppy introductions, and hand stripping.

features.name: Booking handoff
features.description: Pre-filled email enquiries and click-to-call links carry visitors from their selected groom into direct contact.

features.name: Salon visit details
features.description: A dedicated route presents the address, opening hours, phone number, email, and arrival guidance.

features.name: Structured FAQ
features.description: Four practical first-visit answers are paired with FAQPage JSON-LD for search engines.

templates.name: Quote Slider
templates.summary: A cleaning-service quote page with live room pricing, frequency discounts, URL sharing, print output, and email handoff.
templates.description:
Quote Slider is a focused single-page website for a cleaning service that wants to replace opaque enquiry forms with useful upfront pricing. It helps homeowners understand likely visit costs before contacting the business while keeping the estimate clearly non-binding.

Visitors adjust bedroom and bathroom sliders, then select weekly, biweekly, or one-time cleaning. The itemized estimate updates immediately from explicit base, room, and frequency rules. Selections serialize into the URL and hydrate on direct load, while browser printing and a pre-filled email provide practical ways to save or submit the quote.

Business details, page content, and pricing rules are centralized in committed JSON files for straightforward personalization. The original cleaning-specific visual direction includes responsive layouts, accessible controls, locally optimized photography, dedicated print styles, static Astro output, TypeScript content models, and FAQPage structured data without CRM or invoicing dependencies.

features.name: Live quote builder
features.description: Bedroom, bathroom, and frequency controls update an itemized per-visit cleaning estimate immediately.

features.name: Transparent pricing rules
features.description: Base pricing, room increments, and weekly or biweekly discounts remain visible beside the calculated quote.

features.name: URL-backed quote state
features.description: Every selection is serialized into the URL and restored on reload or direct entry.

features.name: Print and email handoff
features.description: Visitors can print a concise one-page estimate or open a pre-filled email containing the quote details and shareable URL.

features.name: Structured FAQ
features.description: Four practical service questions are paired with matching FAQPage JSON-LD.

templates.name: Flash Sheet
templates.summary: A tattoo studio flash wall with original artwork, motif filters, detailed design pages, and pre-filled enquiries.
templates.description:
Flash Sheet is a distinctive multi-page website for a tattoo studio that wants to present ready-made work with the clarity of a physical studio wall. It helps prospective clients browse one-off designs while seeing practical booking information before making contact.

Visitors can filter eight original flash pieces by motif, open each design on its own direct-load route, and review its size, suggested placement, guide price, availability, and artwork. Every claim action opens an honest enquiry flow with the selected design already filled in, without presenting a deposit checkout or artist calendar.

Studio details, FAQs, contact information, and flash inventory are centralized in committed JSON files for straightforward personalization. Eight original local SVG artworks, shared rendering components, responsive plain CSS, accessible controls, FAQPage structured data, React Router, TypeScript, and a static Vite build provide a polished base for a real tattoo studio site.

features.name: Filterable flash wall
features.description: Eight one-off designs can be filtered by botanical, creature, talisman, and oddity motifs.

features.name: Design detail routes
features.description: Every piece has a direct-load route showing original artwork, size, placement, guide price, and availability.

features.name: Filled enquiry handoff
features.description: Claim actions clearly open a pre-filled email enquiry without implying payment or reservation.

features.name: Original flash artwork
features.description: Eight locally stored SVG illustrations provide a cohesive, tattoo-specific visual collection.

features.name: Structured FAQ
features.description: Four practical booking answers are paired with FAQPage JSON-LD.

templates.name: Moving Day
templates.summary: A removals company homepage with a room-by-room estimator, van recommendation, guide price, and direct quote handoff.
templates.description:
Moving Day is a polished single-page website for a small removals firm that wants to give customers useful pricing guidance before they call. It is designed for local movers serving households that need a reassuring, straightforward way to understand what their move may involve.

Visitors select room types and quantities to receive a live volume estimate, recommended van size, and ballpark price. Estimator state is stored in the URL for reloads and sharing, while pre-filled email enquiries, click-to-call actions, service steps, trust signals, customer proof, and practical FAQs carry the journey through to a fixed-quote request.

Company content and contact details live in src/data/site.json, while room volumes, pricing assumptions, and van rules live in src/data/pricing.json. The template combines an original removals-specific visual direction, local photography, accessible controls, responsive Vue architecture, static Vite output, and FAQPage structured data.

features.name: Room-by-room estimator
features.description: Visitors select six room types and quantities using accessible counters.

features.name: Van recommendation
features.description: Selected inventory produces a live volume calculation and suitable vehicle recommendation.

features.name: Guide pricing
features.description: Committed pricing rules produce a transparent ballpark price with clear limitations.

features.name: Shareable estimate state
features.description: Room selections serialize into the URL and hydrate correctly after direct loads or reloads.

features.name: Quote handoff
features.description: Pre-filled email enquiries include selected rooms, volume, recommended van, and guide price.

features.name: Structured FAQ
features.description: Five removals questions are paired with FAQPage JSON-LD.
